description: This Java class implements an immutable version of the DeleteAttributesLiveCommand, a command in a signals API related to live modifications of attribute data. It provides methods to instantiate, answer, and configure the command, specifying its category and behavior.

classes.name: DeleteAttributesLiveCommandImpl
classes.description: An immutable implementation of the DeleteAttributesLiveCommand interface, extending AbstractModifyLiveCommand, providing specific behavior for delete attribute commands within the live signals framework.

methods.name: of
methods.description: Creates a new instance of DeleteAttributesLiveCommandImpl from a generic Command object; casts the command to DeleteAttributes.

methods.name: answer
methods.description: Returns a builder for creating answers to this command.

methods.name: getCategory
methods.description: Returns the category of the command, which is DELETE.

methods.name: setDittoHeaders
methods.description: Creates a new command instance with specified DittoHeaders.

methods.name: changesAuthorization
methods.description: Indicates whether the command alters authorization privileges; returns false.

methods.name: toString
methods.description: Provides a string representation of the command object.
